neighbours.label: The conjunction that adds the last member of an enumeration of three or more items (brain, spinal cord, and optic nerve; имя, адрес, телефон и почта; not to mention), as opposed to the 'and' of a two-item pair or of two clauses
fire: The kit contains a compass, a whistle, a mirror, and a small knife.
Symptoms include fever, headache, stiff neck, and sensitivity to light.
The eye consists of the cornea, the lens, the retina, and the optic nerve.
Participants were drawn from nurses, pharmacists, physiotherapists, and midwives.
В заявке укажите имя, фамилию, телефон и адрес электронной почты.
The study covered wheat, barley, oats, and rye grown on the same plots.
The orchestra needs strings, brass, woodwind, and percussion for this piece.
He packed shirts, socks, a razor, and a paperback, not to mention his camera.
quiet: The kit contains a compass and a small knife.
Symptoms include fever and sensitivity to light.
The eye consists of the lens and the retina.
Participants were drawn from nurses and midwives.
В заявке укажите имя и адрес электронной почты.
The study covered wheat and rye grown on the same plots.
The orchestra tuned up and the audience fell silent.
He packed his bag and left for the station.
